answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 35962 Country: India Title: On the 26th day of Ramadan, at around 3:45 am I had a dream that I am getting in my house and I see a skinless python is lying dead and beside it my fiancée is standing Question: On the 26th day of Ramadan, at around 3:45 am I had a dream that I am getting in my house and I see a skinless python is lying dead and beside it my fiancée is standing. I thought that he had killed that python but later in fraction of seconds the python is invisible and there lies my fiancée unconscious. I request you please guide me regarding this night of mine. Answer ID: 35962 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 262/148/H=1433) The meaning of your dream is that both of you lagged behind in good deeds and tended towards bad practice. You should do tauba and istighfar and reform yourself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
